Upstream: https://github.com/tigergraph/graphrag
Commit: f649f4197f3dc18bf5bd7dd2fb0a0e477a5a70b9

This repository is vendored as the official TigerGraph GraphRAG foundation required by
the hackathon brief. The project-specific LegalGraphRAG implementation in the root
repository customizes it with:

- a legal-opinion schema for LegalCase, Chunk, Citation, Entity, and CommunityReport
- MENTIONS and RELATED_TO entity edges exported for TigerGraph
- EA-GraphRAG-style query routing
- PathRAG-light path scoring and pruning
- Gemini generation, benchmarking, and the React/Node dashboard
